one_liner: Monday.com has a broad GraphQL API with free developer sandbox, personal tokens plus OAuth, and an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: Personal V2 API tokens (static, user-generated) and OAuth 2.0 for apps (new OAuth 2.1 flow with refresh tokens also available). Webhooks are signed with JWT, but that is for verification only.
access_notes: Free developer/sandbox account gives an API token. API is available on all plans including Free (200 calls/day on Free; higher on paid tiers).
blocker_notes: Free-tier daily call limit is low (200), but this is not a blocker for building.
